parts.name: Handle
parts.Basic_description: The handle is the trigger part of the dispenser, made of polypropylene plastic, designed for manual operation.
parts.Functional_description: It is used to pump and release liquid from the bottle through the nozzle when squeezed.
parts.Movement_description: It moves back and forth when pressed by the user's fingers to activate the spray mechanism.

parts.name: Head (Other)
parts.Basic_description: The head is the upper assembly of the dispenser, made of ABS plastic, containing the nozzle and internal pump mechanism.
parts.Functional_description: It channels the liquid from the bottle through the nozzle and controls the spray pattern.
parts.Movement_description: It remains mostly stationary but contains internal moving parts that assist in pumping the liquid.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main container of the dispenser, made of polyethylene plastic, cylindrical in shape.
parts.Functional_description: It stores the liquid to be dispensed and provides structural support for the head and handle.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, serving as the reservoir for the liquid.
